description: Frozen single source of truth for strategy status and parameters. One source of truth per state (AGENTS spec #17). Frozen params MUST NOT change during a daily run (spec #20).

statusEnum.note: Lifecycle status values a strategy may hold. LIVE_OK = { VALIDATED, LIVE } only. Research candidates use TRAINING / BACKTESTED / HOLDOUT_TESTED / PAPER and are EXCLUDED from live picks until a human promotes them (RESEARCH-PLAN.md §6). Dead ends are kept (never deleted) with a status of REJECTED_CANDIDATE and validationStatus BACKTESTED_NEGATIVE so the audit trail of what was tested and rejected survives (AGENTS 'never delete first').

strategies.source: train-model-v5b.mjs k-fold OOS: +16.8% ROI, 95% CI [+2.1%, +32.6%] excludes zero (band re-selected on train; FIXED [1.8,2.2) reference band).

bandDiscrepancy.deployedOverride: REMOVED. agent.yml/betting.yml previously set BAND_LO=1.5 (widened, lower edge, NOT validated). Eliminated (review action #1): all legacy code now reads the frozen band from this registry via lib/1x2.mjs:frozen1X2(); no env variable can widen it.
bandDiscrepancy.resolution: Validated band [1.8, 2.2) is the single authoritative value. Legacy selector, unified engine, manual slip, and auto executor all source it from this frozen registry. BAND_LO/HI env removed from agent.yml + betting.yml.
